title: G1: Rationally generating family of 4k-manifolds without cobordism theory

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Central gap.** The standard proof reduces the signature theorem to checking two ring homomorphisms ($\tau$ and $\langle L,[\cdot]\rangle$) agree on generators of $\Omega^{SO}_*\otimes\mathbb{Q}=\mathbb{Q}[\,[\mathbb{CP}^2],[\mathbb{CP}^4],\dots]$ (Thom). The problem **explicitly bans cobordism theory / Pontryagin–Thom**, so this generation statement is not available off the shelf.

**What must be proved.** In each dimension $4k$, exhibit an explicit finite family of closed oriented manifolds $M^{(1)},\dots,M^{(N)}$ (e.g. products $\mathbb{CP}^{2i_1}\times\cdots\times\mathbb{CP}^{2i_r}$ and Milnor hypersurfaces $H_{i,j}\subset\mathbb{CP}^i\times\mathbb{CP}^j$) whose **Pontryagin-number vectors are linearly independent** (span the space of Pontryagin numbers in degree $4k$, dimension $=p(k)$ = number of partitions of $k$), and on which both $\tau$ and $\langle L,[\cdot]\rangle$ can be computed in closed form. Then conclude the two linear functionals on Pontryagin-number space coincide.

**Risk to audit:** any argument that 'these manifolds generate rationally' must not covertly re-invoke $\Omega^{SO}_*\otimes\mathbb{Q}$; the spanning must be a direct (e.g. determinant/Vandermonde-type) computation. This is the hardest gap and the reason 'elementary' is a real constraint.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
**Resolution of G1 (rationally generating family without cobordism theory).**

I audited and verified the existing spanning argument (§3–4, Thm. *Spanning*) and tightened its one soft spot. The section now constitutes a *complete, self-contained, cobordism-free* proof of exactly what the issue demands.

**What is established (all verified numerically/symbolically):**

1. **Explicit family.** For each partition $\mu\in P(k)$, $M_\mu=\prod_s \mathbb{CP}^{2\mu_s}$ — a family of exactly $p(k)$ closed oriented $4k$-manifolds.

2. **Closed-form Pontryagin numbers.** Using only the Euler sequence / Whitney formula computation $p(T\mathbb{CP}^n)=(1+h^2)^{n+1}$ (proved from scratch in §1) and the pairing rule, the power-sum Pontryagin numbers are
$\mathfrak p_\lambda[M_\mu]=\big[\prod_s t_s^{\mu_s}\big]\prod_i\big(\sum_s(2\mu_s+1)t_s^{\lambda_i}\big)$, a finite integer combinatorial sum $\sum_f \prod_i(2\mu_{f(i)}+1)$ over balanced functions $f$. I cross-checked formula (7) against an independent symbolic expansion in the cohomology of the product for all $k\le5$: **exact match**.

3. **Direct (non-cobordism) spanning via a triangular determinant.** Ordering $P(k)$ by dominance, $\mathfrak p_\lambda[M_\mu]\ne0\Rightarrow\lambda\preceq\mu$ (Coarsening-dominates lemma) and diagonal entries are strictly positive. I verified triangularity (no violations) and positive diagonal for **all $k\le8$**, and confirmed the determinants $3,90,17010,1653372000,4640436523800000$ for $k=1,\dots,5$ — matching the values claimed in the text. So $\det\ne0$, the Pontryagin vectors span $\mathbb{Q}^{P(k)}$. This is a pure Vandermonde-type determinant computation; **$\Omega^{SO}_*\otimes\mathbb{Q}$ is never invoked here.**

4. **Closed-form functional values.** $\tau(M_\mu)=1$ (rank-one positive intersection form, multiplicativity) and $L[M_\mu]=1$ via the residue computation $[h^{2m}](h/\tanh h)^{2m+1}=[w^{2m}](1-w^2)^{-1}=1$ — verified symbolically for $m\le6$. Hence both functionals agree on the spanning family, forcing $\tau=L[\cdot]$ on degree-$4k$ Pontryagin numbers (given Facts (I),(II), which are separate issues).

**Fix applied.** The previous text justified the $p_\lambda\leftrightarrow\mathfrak p_\lambda$ transition by the imprecise phrase "unitriangular up to nonzero scalars." I replaced this with a self-contained **Lemma (Newton change of basis; invertibility)**: from Newton's identities $\mathfrak p_i=(-1)^{i-1} i\,e_i+(\text{poly in }e_{<i})$, the products $\mathfrak p_\lambda$ expand in the $p_\mu$ basis triangularly *with respect to the refinement order* with nonzero diagonal $\prod_i(-1)^{\lambda_i-1}\lambda_i$, hence the transition matrix is invertible over $\mathbb{Q}$. I verified the refinement-triangularity and the exact diagonal value for all $k\le5$.

**Scope note (honest).** This issue (G1) concerns *only* the generating-family/spanning step, and that step is now fully elementary and complete. The distinct upper-bound input $\dim_\mathbb{Q}\Omega^{SO}_{4k}\otimes\mathbb{Q}\le p(k)$ used in Fact (II) is a *separate* matter (handled in §6 / its own issue) and is **not** used anywhere in the spanning argument. The spanning is genuinely a direct determinant computation, as the issue required.

Marking G1 resolved.
